leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a higher-order function that accepts another function as an argument.
Implement a closure to store and track whether the original function has been invoked.
Manipulate the return value to ensure the original function's result is returned only on the first call.
Apply the once utility to a sample function to demonstrate its single-execution behavior.
Control the function's execution path by returning a cached result after the initial invocation.
Integrate the once function into a simple script to observe its practical utility.
lessonTitle: Write a custom once function utility
